# http

```go
import "budget2/internal/http"
```

Package http contains small HTTP utility helpers shared across handler packages: template rendering wrappers, structured error responses, and query\-parameter parsing \(date ranges, etc.\). It is intentionally lightweight — handlers own their own routing and middleware.
